tim_output.campaign_summary: Akira is a ransomware group active since March 2023 that primarily targets small- and medium-sized businesses across North America, Europe, and Australia, with a particular focus on educational institutions and critical infrastructure in manufacturing, IT, healthcare, finance, and food/agriculture sectors. The threat actors exploit unpatched vulnerabilities in VPNs and internet-facing applications (including CVE-2024-40766 in SonicWall), abuse valid credentials through brute-forcing and password spraying, and deploy dual encryptors (Megazord and Akira variants) to encrypt both Windows and Linux/ESXi systems, as well as Nutanix hypervisors. They employ a double-extortion model involving both encryption and data exfiltration, using legitimate tools for lateral movement and command-and-control while evading detection, and have accumulated approximately $244 million in claimed ransomware proceeds as of September 2025.
